scientific_integrity: Exhaustiveness is justified by the published strict bound \(ab<2^{11}\). The standalone verifier enumerates all compatible binary exponent triples and independently repeats the bounded integer census.
scientific_limitations: The theorem classifies only the asymmetric binary-weight slice \((k,\ell,m)=(3,2,3)\) for positive odd factors. It relies on the published general \(k=3\) bound and does not classify neighboring weight triples.
title: Exact \((3,2,3)\) binary-weight product classification
